notes: First playtest build of Crafter's Path for Windows.
All four chapters: AerCrafting, HydroCrafting, TerraCrafting and EmberCrafting, with a Master duel in each land.
Story ending with the duel at the Summit.
New Journal menu with a Map tab.
Works with a controller or keyboard.
Unzip the whole folder and keep the .pck files next to Crafter's Path.exe.
